name: far-terrain-cache
about: Hop 300 yards away from a hill in the Barrens and back. The game draws far ground with its coarse mesh (64 to 76 triangles a chunk) through a shader the terrain test does not know; the cache must not keep those draws once you are back, or their full shade lies over the hill in big triangles (2026-10-03).

start.about: taken from the owner's probe, flying, facing about 39 degrees from the x axis, toward the mountain: the hops go the other way (219) and come back

expect.about: No coarse ground the files hold is left in the cache near you
No game draw of ground the files cover is held as a caster (the far horizon copy included)
expect.probe: fixed-function entry: .*the files cover it: yes
